title: Mizzou veterinarians give young racehorse a second chance
summary_en: After discovering an extremely rare cyst in the horse’s windpipe, Mizzou experts successfully treated the condition, work that may help other veterinarians identify similar cases in the future.

title: MU Extension helps turn setbacks into new beginnings
summary_en: Through Missouri AgrAbility, University of Missouri Extension provides free, personalized support for agricultural workers with injuries, illnesses and disabilities.
title_cn: MU Extension helps turn setbacks into new beginnings

title: Mizzou on the front lines of tracking tick-borne diseases in Missouri
summary_en: Efforts by Mizzou’s Veterinary Medical Diagnostic Laboratory are informing cattle management decisions for livestock producers statewide.
title_cn: Mizzou on the front lines of tracking tick-borne diseases in Missouri

title: University of Missouri (UM) System Critical Materials Crossroads Engine selected for $160 million NSF award
summary_en: Led by University of Missouri-Kansas City, this regional consortium includes all four institutions of the UM System — the University of Missouri, Missouri University of Science and Technology, the University of Missouri-St. Louis and UMKC. This partnership will build an ecosystem to ensure national security and energy independence as well as economic development.
